description: This file declares the interface IServerFactory for creating IPC server instances within the Rialto project. It defines a factory class with methods to create server objects, and includes licensing and include guards.

classes.name: IServerFactory
classes.description: An interface for creating IPC server instances, providing factory methods to instantiate server objects.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IServerFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create and return a shared pointer to an IServer object.
